from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [any(v != bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    bands=[]
    i=0
    while i<h:
        if active[i]:
            j=i+1
            while j<h and active[j]: j+=1
            bands.append((i,j))
            i=j
        else: i+=1
    if len(bands)!=2 or bands[0][1]-bands[0][0] != bands[1][1]-bands[1][0]:
        return out
    a,b=bands
    n=a[1]-a[0]
    def ray(row):
        color=row[-1]
        if color==bg: return False
        k=w-1
        while k>=0 and row[k]==color: k-=1
        return w-1-k >= 3
    for off in range(n):
        r1,r2=a[0]+off,b[0]+off
        q1,q2=ray(grid[r1]),ray(grid[r2])
        if q1 and not q2:
            last=max(i for i,v in enumerate(grid[r2]) if v!=bg)
            for c in range(last+1,w): out[r2][c]=1
        elif q2 and not q1:
            last=max(i for i,v in enumerate(grid[r1]) if v!=bg)
            for c in range(last+1,w): out[r1][c]=1
    return out

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [any(value != background for value in row) for row in grid]
    bands = []
    row = 0
    while row < h:
        if not active[row]:
            row += 1
            continue
        end = row + 1
        while end < h and active[end]:
            end += 1
        bands.append((row, end))
        row = end
    if len(bands) != 2 or bands[0][1] - bands[0][0] != bands[1][1] - bands[1][0]:
        return out

    def reaches_right_edge(row):
        color = row[-1]
        if color == background:
            return False
        col = len(row) - 1
        while col >= 0 and row[col] == color:
            col -= 1
        return len(row) - 1 - col >= 3

    first, second = bands
    for offset in range(first[1] - first[0]):
        a, b = first[0] + offset, second[0] + offset
        a_reaches = reaches_right_edge(grid[a])
        b_reaches = reaches_right_edge(grid[b])
        if a_reaches and not b_reaches:
            target = b
        elif b_reaches and not a_reaches:
            target = a
        else:
            continue
        last = max(col for col, value in enumerate(grid[target]) if value != background)
        for col in range(last + 1, w):
            out[target][col] = 1
    return out
'''

program2='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active_rows = [any(value != background for value in row) for row in grid]
    bands = []
    row = 0
    while row < height:
        if not active_rows[row]:
            row += 1
            continue
        end = row + 1
        while end < height and active_rows[end]:
            end += 1
        bands.append((row, end))
        row = end
    if len(bands) != 2 or bands[0][1] - bands[0][0] != bands[1][1] - bands[1][0]:
        return out

    first, second = bands
    for offset in range(first[1] - first[0]):
        a, b = first[0] + offset, second[0] + offset
        end_a = max(col for col, value in enumerate(grid[a]) if value != background)
        end_b = max(col for col, value in enumerate(grid[b]) if value != background)
        if end_a > end_b:
            for col in range(end_b + 1, end_a + 1):
                out[b][col] = 1
        elif end_b > end_a:
            for col in range(end_a + 1, end_b + 1):
                out[a][col] = 1
    return out
'''

def transform_aligned(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active=[any(v!=bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    bands=[]; i=0
    while i<h:
        if not active[i]: i+=1; continue
        j=i+1
        while j<h and active[j]: j+=1
        bands.append((i,j)); i=j
    if len(bands)!=2 or bands[0][1]-bands[0][0]!=bands[1][1]-bands[1][0]: return out
    first,second=bands; n=first[1]-first[0]
    ends=[]
    for k in range(n):
        a=grid[first[0]+k]; b=grid[second[0]+k]
        ends.append((max(c for c,v in enumerate(a) if v!=bg),max(c for c,v in enumerate(b) if v!=bg)))
    opts=[]
    for s in range(-3,4):
        mismatches=count=0
        for k,(ea,eb) in enumerate(ends):
            lo=max(0,-s); hi=min(ea,eb-s,w-1-s)
            for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                mismatches += ((grid[first[0]+k][c]!=bg)!=(grid[second[0]+k][c+s]!=bg))
                count+=1
        if count:
            opts.append((mismatches/count,-count,abs(s),s,mismatches,count))
    shift=min(opts)[3]
    for k,(ea,eb) in enumerate(ends):
        ra=first[0]+k; rb=second[0]+k
        ea_b=ea+shift
        eb_a=eb-shift
        if ea_b>eb:
            for c in range(eb+1,min(ea_b,w-1)+1):
                ca=c-shift
                if 0<=ca<w and grid[ra][ca]!=bg: out[rb][c]=1
        elif eb_a>ea:
            for c in range(ea+1,min(eb_a,w-1)+1):
                cb=c+shift
                if 0<=cb<w and grid[rb][cb]!=bg: out[ra][c]=1
    return out,shift,opts

# Quick test shift and expected known demos

program6='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [any(value != background for value in row) for row in grid]
    bands = []
    row = 0
    while row < height:
        if not active[row]:
            row += 1
            continue
        end = row + 1
        while end < height and active[end]:
            end += 1
        bands.append((row, end))
        row = end
    if len(bands) != 2 or bands[0][1] - bands[0][0] != bands[1][1] - bands[1][0]:
        return out

    first, second = bands
    row_ends = []
    for offset in range(first[1] - first[0]):
        a, b = grid[first[0] + offset], grid[second[0] + offset]
        end_a = max(col for col, value in enumerate(a) if value != background)
        end_b = max(col for col, value in enumerate(b) if value != background)
        row_ends.append((end_a, end_b))

    alignments = []
    for shift in range(-3, 4):
        mismatches = compared = 0
        for offset, (end_a, end_b) in enumerate(row_ends):
            a = grid[first[0] + offset]
            b = grid[second[0] + offset]
            left = max(0, -shift)
            right = min(end_a, end_b - shift, width - 1 - shift)
            for col in range(left, right + 1):
                mismatches += (a[col] != background) != (b[col + shift] != background)
                compared += 1
        if compared:
            alignments.append((mismatches / compared, -compared, abs(shift), shift))
    shift = min(alignments)[3]

    for offset, (end_a, end_b) in enumerate(row_ends):
        row_a, row_b = first[0] + offset, second[0] + offset
        end_a_in_b = end_a + shift
        end_b_in_a = end_b - shift
        if end_a_in_b > end_b:
            for col_b in range(end_b + 1, min(end_a_in_b, width - 1) + 1):
                col_a = col_b - shift
                if 0 <= col_a < width and grid[row_a][col_a] != background:
                    out[row_b][col_b] = 1
        elif end_b_in_a > end_a:
            for col_a in range(end_a + 1, min(end_b_in_a, width - 1) + 1):
                col_b = col_a + shift
                if 0 <= col_b < width and grid[row_b][col_b] != background:
                    out[row_a][col_a] = 1
    return out
'''
